originalTitle: CCTV and zip ties: How US mail-in votes are secured and counted
summary: BBC Verify goes to an election centre to get a behind-the-scenes look at how mail-in ballots for the US midterm elections are processed.
content:
Ahead of the US midterm elections on 3 November, President Trump continues to make unsubstantiated claims that mail-in voting leads to widespread fraud.

US states have different voting rules and regulations - but every state allows some postal voting, a method the president says he has used in the past.

BBC Verify visited an election centre in Maryland to get a behind-the-scenes look at how mail-in ballots are processed and counted.

Produced by Mabel Pickering. Graphics by Sally Nicholls.
chineseTitle: 闭路电视和扎带：美国邮寄选票的安全和计数方式
chineseSummary: BBC verify 前往选举中心，深入了解美国中期选举邮寄选票的处理方式。
chineseContent:
在 11 月 3 日美国中期选举之前，特朗普总统继续毫无根据地声称邮寄投票会导致广泛的欺诈行为。

美国各州有不同的投票规则和规定，但每个州都允许进行邮寄投票，总统表示他过去曾使用过这种方法。

BBC Verify 访问了马里兰州的一个选举中心，深入了解邮寄选票的处理和计票方式。

由梅布尔·皮克林制作。莎莉·尼克尔斯制图。
